# Maximum Overhang Angle

Maximum angle of unsupported downward-facing surfaces, from the vertical.

<figure markdown="span">
![Maximum Overhang Angle: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-overhang-angle-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Maximum Overhang Angle: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-overhang-angle-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Angle of downward-facing surfaces, measured from the vertical.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 45° | 55° | Not yet sourced |
    | PLA | 50° | 60° | Not yet sourced |
    | PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | 48° | 55° | Not yet sourced |
    | PETG | 42° | 50° | Not yet sourced |
    | ABS | 40° | 45° | Not yet sourced |
    | ASA | 40° | 45° | Not yet sourced |
    | TPU (Flexible) | 35° | 40° | Not yet sourced |
    | PA | 38° | 45° | Not yet sourced |
    | PA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | 42° | 50° | Not yet sourced |
    | PC | 38° | 45° | Not yet sourced |


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 70° | 80° | Aim for: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: overhangs flatter than 19° from level need support, about 71° from vertical")<br>At most: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3 and 4: 10° from level, 80° from vertical") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Overhang angle `{measured}` exceeds the recommended `{target}`. Each layer overhangs further than the material can self-support. Expect drooping and rough texture on the underside.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Overhang angle `{measured}` exceeds the `{limit}` limit. Extruded filament has nothing to rest on and will sag or curl. Add supports, chamfer the edge, or reorient the part.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Overhang (`{measured}` from vertical): past the recommended `{target}`. Faces this flat need supports, which leave marks where they are removed. Tilt the part or add supports.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Unsupported overhang (`{measured}` from vertical): past `{limit}`, nearly flat. Without supports it can break off during the peel. Add supports or tilt the part.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
